args.root_cause: The OPS-250 deploy (raise max-players 20 to 40) pushed a server.properties that also set white-list=true and enforce-whitelist=true. whitelist.json was empty, so every player, including Alex_Builds and Steve_Mines, was rejected with "You are not whitelisted". The previous file is in deploy/previous/server.properties.
args.actions: Checked status and logs. The server was restarted by the deploy. Compared server.properties with deploy/previous/server.properties and found the whitelist changes. Declared the incident. Rewrote server.properties with white-list=false and enforce-whitelist=false, keeping max-players=40. The running server had already loaded the bad config and still rejected players, so I ran the console command "whitelist off" instead of restarting. I did not restart the server myself. Afterwards both players were back online, TPS was 20 and mspt was low.
args.residual_risk: The whitelist was switched off at runtime, and server.properties on disk is also fixed, so the next restart will keep it off. The deploy process has no check for unintended property changes. Whether the server should use a whitelist at all is a decision for the team. The server runs with online-mode=false, so usernames are not authenticated.
